ada:numberOfReplicates: N — variable number of spots per sample
ada:analysisInclusionAndRejectionCriteri: Partially — the reported values are averages per meteorite (Table E4 of the data file), with the complete set of analyses also released (p.6); trace-element chromatograms were "scrutinized for unanticipated interferences, improperly chosen backgrounds or other problems" (p.5). No acceptance or rejection rule is stated for the LA data. The paper's detailed filters — analysis sums 100 ± 2%, stoichiometry limits, Grubb's test rejecting at p<0.01 and tagging at p<0.05, an FeO ceiling of 17.5 wt% for Phillips County, and a zoning profile excluded from that mean — are stated for the EMPA data (p.3) and are not borrowed here
